stories.title: New AI Taskforce names Patrick Vallance as chair
stories.summary: The UK government's new AI Taskforce, set up in the wake of DSIT's dissolution, has named former chief scientific adviser Patrick Vallance as chair to steer government AI adoption.

stories.title: London buys vote counting tools and plans tourist tax IT system in £17.5m tech deals
stories.summary: London authorities have signed off £17.5m in new technology contracts covering vote-counting systems and a tourist tax IT platform, a fresh signal of continued public sector tech procurement activity.

stories.title: *NEW RESEARCH* UK public sector SITS suppliers, trends & forecasts 2026
stories.summary: TechMarketView has published new research on UK public sector systems integration and tech services (SITS) suppliers, covering market trends and forecasts for 2026 amid the Burnham government's restructuring of DSIT.

stories.title: New zero click threat identified by NCSC
stories.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre has flagged a new 'zero click' cyber threat, reportedly linked to Russia, raising fresh security considerations for government technology systems.

stories.title: Research Report — Building No. 10 North (re-state.co.uk)
stories.summary: Re:State's July 2026 'Plan for Government' report sets out a blueprint for Burnham's new 'No 10 North' hub in Manchester, warning it must not become symbolism, be too small, or replicate Whitehall culture. It proposes four core units (Devolution, Subnational Investment & Growth, System Democratisation, Local Public Services Innovation) plus a Transformation Directorate, with a strong emphasis on devolving fiscal powers and reducing central micromanagement of local systems.

topics.name: Parliament
topics.description: House of Commons, House of Lords, PMQs, debates, legislation

stories.title: Commons and Lords remain in summer recess
stories.summary: Both the House of Commons and House of Lords are in summer recess; the Commons is not scheduled to sit again until 1 September 2026, meaning no floor business over the Fri–Mon period.

stories.title: Healey sets budget for late October, promising to 'spread money and power' around UK
stories.summary: Chancellor John Healey has set the date for the next Budget for late October, framing it around a pledge to redistribute money and power away from Westminster and towards the regions, in line with Burnham's devolution agenda.

stories.title: 'Stench of sleaze': Farage struck deal over political return, reports claim
stories.summary: New reports allege Nigel Farage struck a deal linked to his political comeback, prompting opposition claims of a 'stench of sleaze' hanging over Reform UK's leadership arrangements.

stories.title: Rupert Lowe urges Nigel Farage to work with Restore Britain
stories.summary: Former Reform MP Rupert Lowe has publicly urged Farage to cooperate with the rival Restore Britain movement, highlighting continued fractures on the UK right.

stories.title: The tangled financial web at the heart of Reform UK
stories.summary: An investigation into Reform UK's finances outlines a complex web of donors and vehicles funding the party, adding to scrutiny of its transparency ahead of Farage's return to the front line.
